## Landed · 2026-11-15T11:57Z

PR #33767 merged as `f8f35db8` (ACCEPT 6893355893; contract review PASS 6892582974). `--effort LEVEL` (and `--author-effort` / `--ask-effort`) now reaches `claude --effort` on every live turn. The level is checked against the CLI's own `--help` before any card runs. The caller's `CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL` is folded into `--effort` and kept out of each turn's environment, so the record names the effort that ran. Every turn records `requestedEffort`, and the scorecard shows it beside the served model. `external:` passes `limits.effort`, and `codex` and `recorded:` refuse the flags. `pm:dispatched` dropped; card thread closing. Queue ① continues with #33740.
